# QueryComplexityScaling

**Domain**: TCC
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
The measure of how the number of required queries grows with pool size and rarity of target states, used as a key metric in the benchmark. Critical for designing topology-centric interconnects that minimize query latency and energy in rare-event detection tasks.
